title: Plan Lock
description: Sign-off artifact emitted alongside site-plan.json. Records lock status + reasoning so the executor can decide whether to run.

site_plan_path.description: Relative path from this lock file to site-plan.json, typically './site-plan.json'.

ds_contract_path.description: Path to the DS contract used at plan time. Records which DS snapshot the plan was authored against.

critical_gaps_found.description: Gaps on conversion-critical surfaces (hero, primary CTA, pricing on /quote, etc.).

rationale.description: One paragraph human-readable explanation of the lock status. Mandatory when status != 'passed'.

operator_overrides.description: If status was 'needs_ds_extension' and the operator chose to ship anyway, this records the override + the gaps accepted.

next_steps.description: Concrete instructions for the operator. Always populated when status != 'passed'.
